quote: A game where you don’t want to know the main characters is a bad game. Also releasing a game in big 2026 with 30fps is underwhelming and trash af. Story is way too boring, bloom is trash, colors are weird (everything feels bleached out) world feels empty and and and.. only casual gamer who didn’t play many games just rate this game as good. The graphics btw are standard nowadays and i feel like rockstar used AI too for their game. Its a total scam
